id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

name.description:
Human-readable name identifier for the asset.
Used for display purposes and asset identification.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

facility.description:
The facility where this asset is located.
Links the asset to its parent facility for organizational purposes.

level.description:
The criticality level classification of the asset.
Determines maintenance priority and monitoring requirements.

riskScore.description:
Risk assessment score from 0-100.
Higher scores indicate greater risk requiring more attention.
Used for prioritization and alerting systems.

status.description:
Current operational status of the asset.
Determines how the asset is displayed and filtered in UI components.
Values include: OPERATIONAL, MAINTENANCE, OFFLINE, WARNING, ERROR

title:
Demo asset entity for UI testing and demonstration purposes.

This type represents a simplified asset model used in the Asset Performance UI library
for testing components, filters, and data visualization features.


// Create a demo asset
UiApDemoAsset.make({
  name: "Pump-001",
  facility: facility,
  level: criticalLevel,
  riskScore: 85,
  status: UiApDemoAssetStatusEnum.OPERATIONAL
}).create()
name: UiApDemoAsset
